''See also: [[Beast King Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-11-dreadgod|The Beast King is a legendary figure who has existed for centuries. According to local lore, he was once a boy with physical impairments who formed friendships with ancient [[sacred beasts]] and eventually ascended to the rank of [[Herald]]. He serves as a guardian in the [[Wasteland]], positioned between the territory of the [[dragons]] and Akura clan{{!}}Akura lands. His presence is considered vital to the stability of human civilization, as it is believed he prevents the [[Blackflame Empire]] from becoming a desert ravaged by war. He is currently engaged in an ongoing battle against the [[Dreadgods]] and spends nearly all of his time focused on this conflict. He is known to provide protection to certain individuals, such as [[Ziel of the Wasteland]], and may view those under his care as potential weapons against [[dragons]]. He is capable of perceiving the spiritual state of others at a glance and has been known to assign tasks to those he finds useful.}}

== Appearance ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-11-dreadgod|The Beast King is seen sitting on a log while eating meat.}}

== Personality ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-11-dreadgod|A legendary figure, he acts as a patron and protector to Ziel of the Wasteland{{!}}Ziel. He serves as a guardian of human civilization alongside other [[Heralds]], working to keep cults in check and fighting against the [[Dreadgods]].}}

== Ghostwater ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-05-ghostwater|The Beast King is a legendary figure who rose to the rank of [[Herald]] after befriending ancient [[sacred beasts]] as a crippled boy. Acting as one of the guardians for human civilization, he holds territory within the [[Wasteland]] located between the [[dragon]] lands and Akura clan territory{{!}}Akura territory. He serves as a patron and protector to Ziel of the Wasteland{{!}}Ziel, often appearing while sitting on a log eating meat.}}
